## Flagship Systems & Key Contributions

### 1. QuantumJet AI & BioMonitor CBG Suite
- **Domain:** Industrial Clean Energy / Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) Telemetry
- **Description:** Real-time industrial data intelligence platform combining plant telemetry (pH, COD, electrical parameters, gas production) with chemical stock forecasting and automated MIS reporting.
- **Key Engineering Work:** Live plant health heatmaps, Cloudinary receipt verification for petty cash ledgers, custom Excel export styling via `xlsx-js-style`, and automated Gate Pass & Diesel tracking workflows.
- **URL:** https://cbg.quantumjet.co.in/

### 2. OBFS & QuantumJet KrishiOS
- **Domain:** Agritech / Precision Agriculture
- **Description:** Outcome-based agricultural decision engine synthesizing soil chemical tests, satellite NDVI vegetation data, and localized weather inputs to provide surgical fertilizer dosage recommendations.
- **Key Engineering Work:** Algorithmic recommendation logic, soil nutrient parsing, satellite vegetation indices integration, and responsive farmer dashboard.
- **URL:** https://krishios.quantumjet.co.in/ | https://obfs.in

### 3. NetWorth Wealth Tracker
- **Domain:** Fintech / Personal Finance Dashboard
- **Description:** Centralized wealth management application aggregating bank accounts, credit card utilization, live mutual fund NAVs, stock holdings, and loan amortization.
- **Stack:** MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), Financial APIs.
- **URL:** https://bestnetworthtracker.vercel.app

### 4. Create React App (Meta Open Source)

- **Contribution:** Pull Request #17061 merged into Facebook/Meta's `create-react-app` repository, resolving template initialization edge cases.
- **PR URL:** https://github.com/facebook/create-react-app/pull/17061
